bigint.invariant: Every operation matches Python exactly, including floor division of negatives
bigint.oracle: Python's native int, which is itself arbitrary precision

cc.oracle: gcc AND clang must agree on every case

cmark.invariant: Output is byte-identical to the spec's expected HTML, nothing normalised
cmark.oracle: The specification's own spec.json: 652 exact markdown/HTML pairs

commitq.invariant: No commit is ever created with a date other than now
commitq.oracle: Throwaway repos in a temp directory

corex.invariant: Every value printed agrees with gdb, or it is not printed
corex.oracle: gdb: registers, backtrace and mappings compared value by value

derx.invariant: Every element matches asn1parse byte for byte, or is refused with a message
derx.oracle: openssl asn1parse and x509, as a diff
derx.tests: 10822 DER elements compared against openssl asn1parse

dwarfdump.invariant: Every fact printed agrees with readelf

gitobj.blurb: git object database reader and writer
gitobj.invariant: Every object read hashes back to its own name, loose or packed, through the whole delta chain
gitobj.oracle: The object name itself: git chose the filename, we recompute the SHA-1. Plus git verify-pack -v, field by field

httpd.invariant: No request can read a byte outside the document root
httpd.oracle: curl as reference client, RFC 9112 for the error cases

inflate.invariant: gzip accepts all we emit; we decode all it emits
inflate.oracle: gzip -d accepts our output, both directions

jail.invariant: An ungranted path is never reachable; the child cannot relax itself
jail.oracle: The kernel: denied means EACCES, verified

jsonc.invariant: A crash can never score as a rejection; exit status outside {0,1} is a failure

lnk.invariant: Every executable emitted runs, or we refused to emit it
lnk.oracle: The kernel runs the binary, or it does not

mydiff.invariant: The loop closes both ways: our diff feeds GNU patch, GNU's diff feeds our -p
mydiff.oracle: GNU diff byte-identical, and GNU patch applies our output

pngc.blurb: PNG decoder, all colour types and Adam7
pngc.invariant: A corrupt file is refused by CRC, never rendered as a wrong image
pngc.oracle: PngSuite: 162 images that must decode, 14 that must be refused

prof.invariant: Profiling does not change the profiled program
prof.oracle: A planted hot loop with known 10:1 ratios

psh.invariant: Identical stdout and status to dash on every corpus script

rx.invariant: A pc enters a thread list at most once per input position

seccompc.invariant: A syscall the policy did not permit never runs, by any entry point
seccompc.oracle: The kernel, plus an i386 probe driving the 32-bit bypass

sha2.invariant: Byte-exact against published vectors; not constant-time, and says so first
sha2.oracle: NIST CAVP vectors, plus hashlib, coreutils and openssl agreeing

slab.invariant: Two live allocations never overlap; every pointer aligned
slab.oracle: Real programs must produce identical output

sockv.invariant: Every socket the kernel reports is listed once with every field as given

sqlr.invariant: Byte-identical output to SQLite; malformed input errors, never crashes

srcdiff.invariant: No false negatives in HIGH, few enough FPs to stay visible

tarx.invariant: GNU tar agrees both ways, and no member escapes the destination

tlp.invariant: Every disagreement reported is a real one, and a run that finds nothing is distinguishable from a run that tested nothing
tlp.oracle: A relation SQLite must satisfy with itself, so no second engine is needed; plus planted bugs proving the oracles can fail

tomlc.invariant: Valid documents parse to the expected value, not merely without error

trace.invariant: Tracing does not change the traced program

tzf.invariant: Every instant answered agrees with both readers; malformed input is refused
tzf.oracle: zdump and Python's zoneinfo must both agree

unrepro.invariant: Never report clean on a build that is not reproducible
unrepro.oracle: Planted causes, each asserting its diagnosis

utf8n.invariant: Normalising twice equals normalising once, for every form on every input
utf8n.tests: UCD 18.0.0: 5982 decomp records, 6828 pool words, 422 ccc ranges, 961 composites, 1120 exclusions

vtparse.invariant: Never allocates, never reads past its byte, matches the table
vtparse.oracle: The published DEC state table, all 3584 pairs

walkv.invariant: Recovered state is a prefix with no holes
walkv.oracle: A crash injected at every I/O boundary

wasmi.invariant: A malformed module is rejected or traps, never corrupts the host

xmlc.invariant: Acceptance is exactly the XML 1.0 Fifth Edition grammar, and no input crashes, overreads or leaks
xmlc.oracle: The W3C XML Conformance Test Suite: 2585 catalogued cases, vendored unmodified

zipc.invariant: The central directory is authoritative, and no member can ever be written outside the destination
zipc.oracle: Info-ZIP unzip 6.00 and zip 3.0, bidirectionally, across every method and flag combination
